articles.summary: Ambient AI delivers roughly 10x the engagement of first-generation conversational AI Customers acted on 98% of critical nudges, leading to expedited issue resolution Extreme Networks , Inc. (NASDAQ: EXTR) today announced strong early momentum with Extreme Agent ONE™ Coworker , the built-in, ambient, context-aware AI agent for Extreme Platform ONE™ . In the first month of availability, customers collectively saved an estimated 1,000 hours of troubleshooting, and users responded to 98% of critical nudges. Early engagement with Agent ONE Coworker was roughly 10x that of Extreme’s first-generation conversational AI agent, signaling that enterprise organizations are ready for AI that proactively surfaces potential network issues. articles.summary: Revenue climbs 10% on seven straight quarters of double-digit growth S trong Extreme Platform ONETM Bookings help drive SaaS ARR growth up 22% Extreme Networks, Inc. (“Extreme”) (Nasdaq: EXTR) today released financial results for its first quarter ended September 30, 2026. “Extreme delivered its seventh consecutive quarter of double-digit year-over-year growth in Q1. Demand for Extreme Platform ONE continues to accelerate, with strong quarter-over-quarter subscription gains. Platform ONE bookings are now over 50% of subscription bookings, up 5x from the prior year. Based on the strength of our business and visibility of demand for our solutions, we are confident in calling 10% growth next quarter and for the rest of the year. articles.summary: Planned for the first half of CY27, Extreme Exchange zones will bring AI skills to branch and edge sites, designed for data sovereignty, localization, survivability, and better economics Extreme Networks , Inc. (NASDAQ: EXTR) today previewed its roadmap for on-prem enterprise AI. Extreme Exchange zones bring enterprise AI on-premises, allowing customers to choose their level of data sovereignty and control. Enterprises can run the same AI applications locally and in the cloud, wherever their data originates and workloads run, with full control over data residency and processing. Organizations will also be able to pool compute resources, including spare capacity on Extreme access points and switches already deployed at branch offices, retail locations, and other distributed sites, to run AI applications and plug-ins.
